archival_doi.reason: DOI minting requires an external archival service/repository integration and is not a scientific, reproducibility, or manuscript-structure code gate.
archival_doi.action_before_formal_release: Mint archival DOI externally after the exact submission files are frozen, then add it to CITATION.cff/release metadata without changing frozen scientific results.

remaining_publication_operations: prepare an anonymised reviewer code/data bundle from the frozen submission surface
fill human-supplied title-page metadata: correspondence email, ORCID, funding, and acknowledgements
complete the full Supporting Information text from the frozen outline without promoting excluded exploratory programs
export the review manuscript with journal-appropriate line numbering, page numbering, and spacing
tag the exact submission commit as v0.1.0 when the submission bundle is frozen
mint and record an archival DOI when the external archive is ready
science_freeze_policy: Any change to G2 scientific parameters, primary inference semantics, or frozen numerical claims requires a new protocol/version rather than silent replacement of v0.1.0 evidence.
